exact_claim: S-0002: top-200 page objects on own server; five-run median; custom-client PLT
confidence_boundary: Higher for method; limited modern-browser transfer; not load event/live sample
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “we do not work with browsers”; “home pages of the Alexa top 200 websites to our own server”; “repeat our experiments five times and present the median”; first-object-request to last-object-received PLT, explicitly not W3C load.
limitations: Custom HTTP/SPDY clients; same-server consolidation. Five-run median is description, not precision justification.

exact_claim: S-0002: dependency/computation and network conditions can reduce/nullify SPDY gain
confidence_boundary: Limited; historical emulation; 7% scenario-qualified, not universal
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Abstract qualifies 7% by “our lower bandwidth and higher RTT scenarios”; §5.2 says dependencies and computation “reduce and can easily nullify the benefits of SPDY”; single connection detrimental under high loss.
limitations: Epload emulates computational delays; no universal 7% gain or modern-browser benefit.

exact_claim: S-0003: 98% multi-server prevalence/500-page corpus differ from 20-page × 25 live/replay comparison
confidence_boundary: Higher design description; limited replay generalization; mean-error medians are not tolerances
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Abstract: multi-server nature present in 98% of Alexa US Top 500; §4.1 only 9/500 single-server. Chrome loads “20 Web pages ... 25 times each”; record immediately following live measurements, then 25 replays. Error compares per-site mean PLTs.
limitations: 500-page prevalence/protocol corpus differs from 20-page live fidelity test; those 20 were CDN-close. Error-summary medians are not universal tolerances.

exact_claim: S-0004: explicit client-visible content/service feature families, not backend complexity
confidence_boundary: Higher definitions; limited new classifier/prediction; seven/nine weeks unresolved and unused
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “complexity ... as visible to browsers on client devices”; not server-side infrastructure. Content complexity: number/size/MIME distribution of objects. Service complexity: numbers and contributions of servers/administrative origins.
limitations: Seven weeks in introduction and nine weeks in methods genuinely conflict; unused duration remains unresolved. No validated new classifier/predictor follows.

exact_claim: S-0005: six synchronized 3×2 visits; 77PX top-25K, three randomized rounds; distinguish queued/nonfatal/complete success
confidence_boundary: Higher controls description; limited endpoint/human generalization; 83.40% context is nonfatal completed visits
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “6 synchronized parallel visits ... 3 network VPs and 2 BCs”; top 25,000 Tranco domains, snapshot 77PX; three repetitions with domain order randomized each round. 450,000 queued, 449,936 nonfatal completed. “Of these completed pages, 375,246 (83.40%) were completely successful”.
limitations: 83.40% denominator is nonfatal completed visits, not domains or all queued visits. Single example per VP class and stealth-human limits retained. Scheduled synchronization is not a claim of perfectly identical start times.

exact_claim: S-0006: >50K opt-in Firefox people and selected crawl/user metric divergence
confidence_boundary: Higher cohort description; limited observational transfer; people/visits/domains differ, fingerprinting counterexample retained
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Abstract: opt-in sample over 50,000 Firefox users; §3.4.1 approximately 52,000 Firefox 67/68 en-US users, 30 million visits, 640,000 domains. Crawler sees more third parties; fingerprinting prevalence closely agrees while script/domain overlap differs. Causal mechanisms not directly studied.
limitations: People/visits/domains distinct; capture capped per navigation at 500 KiB, 10 seconds or 1,000 events. Selected privacy metrics and stateful/stateless differences, not timing or all-user validity.

exact_claim: S-0010: permanent configured-domain list references
confidence_boundary: Higher archive description; limited population inference; not the service webpage or frozen page content
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “permanent record ... lists, their configuration and their construction methods”; permanent short link/citation template, exact domain-set download, configuration overview.
limitations: Original 2019 paper, not A3AT7C2E service item. Domain-list archive does not freeze webpage content or imply an all-web probability sample.

exact_claim: S-0011: 4.5M profile-visit instances versus 178,452 threshold-qualified pages
confidence_boundary: Limited; ranked frame/profile missingness, asynchronous subpages; internal 25/24 and 92% wording not silently repaired
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “Across all profiles, we successfully visited 4.5M pages”; at least 17 successful crawls across 24 profiles for inclusion; “178,452 (92%) ... fall into this category”. Source first says 25 setups then 24, and subsequent subpage starts are unsynchronized.
limitations: 4.5M is aggregate profile-visit instances, not distinct analyzed URLs. Internal 25/24 and percentage wording remains source uncertainty, not silently repaired or used for design.

exact_claim: S-0013: 50-of-200 system sample differs from 100-of-2000 motivation sample
confidence_boundary: Higher sample extraction; limited transfer; fixed baseline-then-treatment order, main repetition count not established
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Motivation: 100 websites chosen at random from top 2000. System: 50 websites chosen at random from Alexa top 200. Each page loaded “first without any optimization, and then via” Klotski.
limitations: Distinct samples; fixed baseline-then-treatment order. Main evaluation repetition count not established by these passages.

exact_claim: S-0014: replay subset/exclusions and matched-object-fetch endpoint, not Polaris loadEventEnd
confidence_boundary: Limited; historical Firefox/rewrite/replay, endpoint non-equivalence; not metric conformance
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: 200 Alexa Top-500 sites, selected to avoid eval()/with() unsupported by Scout. Polaris loadEventEnd indicates scheduler stub only; endpoint is time to fetch the objects fetched between original navigationStart and loadEventEnd.
limitations: Mahimahi replay, Firefox 40, cold browser/DNS cache. Matched-object-fetch endpoint is not Polaris native loadEventEnd or conformance proof.

exact_claim: S-0015: simulated responsiveness excludes concurrent async workers; not framework comparison
anchor: 3.1 About opening / Notes about methodology; Instructions
confidence_boundary: Higher owner scope; limited user representativeness; no run/code audit
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: About: responsiveness by timing simulated user interactions; methodology: “does not attempt to measure concurrent asynchronous work (e.g. in Web Workers)” and “should not be used ... to compare ... different JavaScript frameworks”. Instructions request clean profile/focus/background controls.
limitations: Oct 26 live reaccess, not archived Oct 25 state; headings retain Speedometer 3 wording. No run, code/scoring audit or human representativeness validation.

exact_claim: S-0016: 16,213,084 websites, CrUX-derived selection, chapter-varying pages; empty-cache/logged-out lab differs from field
anchor: 2025 Methodology: About the dataset / Websites / Metrics / Lighthouse
confidence_boundary: Higher documentation; limited all-web transfer; desktop/mobile overlap and separate field data retained
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: 16,213,084 websites; 15,426,398 mobile and 12,155,374 desktop with overlap. URLs from Chrome UX Report. Secondary pages used in many but not all chapters; empty cache/logged-out lab tests; Metrics separately uses CrUX for real-user experiences. Lighthouse 12.8.0 stated for July 2025.
limitations: Oct 26 live reaccess; no all-web population inference, dataset execution or historical page-state proof. Websites, pages and separate field/lab metrics distinguished.

exact_claim: S-0017: homogeneous nuisance blocks and residual randomization
anchor: §5.3.3.2, Blocking used… / Definition… / Block for a few…
confidence_boundary: Higher prose guidance; limited browser adaptation; no additive-model assumption adopted
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “create homogeneous blocks in which the nuisance factors are held constant and the factor of interest is allowed to vary”; “Block what you can, randomize what you cannot”; residual randomization reduces contaminating effects.
limitations: urllib 403; ordinary webfetch succeeded. No additive model/formula/table adopted. Current attributed guidance, not browser independence or historical revision proof.

exact_claim: S-0018: one treatment/three nuisance factors, equal levels, constrained randomization
anchor: §5.3.3.2.2, These designs handle 3 nuisance factors / Randomize as much…
confidence_boundary: Higher documented restrictions; limited browser fit; displayed squares not verified/adopted
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “one treatment factor in the presence of 3 nuisance factors”; “all the factors have the same number of levels”; randomize units/trial order “as much as the design allows”.
limitations: urllib 403; ordinary webfetch succeeded. Displayed squares/run counts/labels not adopted or verified; no universal browser recipe or historical revision proof.

exact_claim: S-0019: full factorial includes every setting combination
anchor: §5.3.3.3, Full factorial designs in two levels, opening definition
confidence_boundary: Higher definition; limited unspecified browser model; crossing ≠ replication/independence
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Every setting of every factor with every setting of every other factor; immediately following prose explicitly says “all possible high/low combinations of all the input factors”.
limitations: urllib 403; ordinary webfetch succeeded. No run-count formula/table adopted. Crossing does not establish replication/independence; current guidance only.

exact_claim: S-0020: adequately chosen fraction, not arbitrary omitted cells
anchor: §5.3.3.4, Full factorial experiments can require many runs / Later sections…
confidence_boundary: Higher definition; indeterminate unchosen fraction; aliasing/ASQC original not inspected
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: NIST attributes ASQC (1983): “only an adequately chosen fraction of the treatment combinations ... selected to be run”; subsequent prose explains appropriate choice of which runs to include, emphasizing two-level designs.
limitations: urllib 403; ordinary webfetch succeeded. Original ASQC and linked aliasing/resolution methods not inspected. Failed cells are not a designed fraction. No historical revision proof.

exact_claim: S-0021: permanent configured lists and changed post-2019 providers
anchor: Home opening update / Access the Tranco ranking / About this service
confidence_boundary: Higher documented history; limited implementation/population inference; selected-list composition must be captured
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Permanent citable references and custom-list configuration. Updates: CrUX/Cloudflare since Aug 1 2023, Farsight since May 1 2022; Alexa deprecated/unavailable; Quantcast removed Apr 1 2020. Attribution names five providers, legacy standard-list sentence says “all four”.
limitations: Oct 26 live reaccess; retain actual chosen list/configuration requirement. No provider-count claim retained, no API/list generation test. Distinct from 2019 paper; current text cannot prove Oct 25 state.

exact_claim: S-0001: minimum of five, 150 complete-run sites among top 200, completion exclusions
confidence_boundary: Limited design reuse; selected minimum/complete cases do not estimate general uncertainty
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “minimum page load time from a total of 5 runs”; Alexa top 200; Selenium hang bugs lead to “results from the 150 websites that provide complete runs”.
limitations: Selected minimum and complete-case sample are not general uncertainty estimates. Bounded passage reread, not whole-paper review.

exact_claim: S-0001: own-server downloaded objects; missing dynamic objects can be 404
confidence_boundary: Limited; not live-browser equivalence
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Own-server controlled experiment with downloaded embedded objects; footnote: unable to download dynamically generated objects, “respond ... with a HTTP 404 error”. Mod_pagespeed reuses setup; alternate machines/locations/random-page settings summarized.
limitations: Own-server resource copy/artificial 404s are not live-site equivalence. Reopened PDF 7,10,11 only, within prior 7–11 read bounds.

exact_claim: S-0007: repetition hierarchy and variance/cost-based allocation with uncertainty
confidence_boundary: Limited browser transfer; native/Java hierarchy not automatic browser hierarchy, no equations imported
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Repeated compilation/execution/iteration sources of variation; repetition most needed where uncertainty arises. §9.3 uses variance estimators/costs for allocation; §10/10.2 addresses ratio uncertainty and counts.
limitations: 11-page local typeset file, PDF+section anchors only; no guessed printed mapping. Publication/DOI edition mapping remains metadata-unresolved in canonical note. No equations/tables/counts imported or automatic browser hierarchy.

exact_claim: S-0007: re-dimension per configuration, iterations may be auto-dependent
confidence_boundary: Higher narrow caution; no transferable count/automatic independence
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: “Re-dimension only if the benchmark/VM/platform changes”; iteration times often “strongly auto-dependent”; do not use dimensioning results at face value, apply method to own systems.
limitations: Same hash-identified 11-page file; printed mapping not guessed. Configuration-specific caution, not automatic steady state, invocation independence or transferable count.

exact_claim: S-0008: native layout/setup bias not sampled by repetitions at fixed setup
confidence_boundary: Limited browser transfer; no effect magnitude imported
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Environment size shifts stack layout; link order affects code/data layout. Repeated, minimally loaded-machine best practices still leave measurement bias; fixed-setup repetition does not vary setup-layout causes.
limitations: Native SPEC/compiler/setup evidence; no effect magnitude imported and no direct browser validation.

exact_claim: S-0008: setup variation/causal checks are qualified remedies, not guaranteed bias removal
confidence_boundary: Limited; setup randomization is not only run-order randomization
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Setup randomization varies link order/environment; causal analysis uses intervention/measurement/confirmation. Setup variation “is not perfect”; causal analysis gives confidence but “does not guarantee” conclusions.
limitations: Setup variation is not merely run-order randomization; no guaranteed bias removal or universal browser procedure.

exact_claim: S-0009: startup/steady-state distinction; shared state may persist across VM invocations
confidence_boundary: Higher narrow warning; not an approved browser discard/reset rule
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Startup includes class loading/JIT, unlike steady state. First VM can change persistent system state: libraries in physical memory and data in disk cache. Authors discard first invocation under an assumption.
limitations: Preserve first-ten-of-twenty-paper read boundary. Original discard suggestion is not adopted as a browser reset/discard rule.

exact_claim: S-0009: aggregate within invocation, uncertainty across invocation means with independence assumptions
confidence_boundary: Limited; first ten of twenty pages only; invocation independence and later Kalibera caution retained
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: First mean across iterations within one invocation, then CI across invocation means. Within-invocation iterations are not independent; §4.1 explicitly warns independence can fail through persistent state; §4.3 describes practical collection.
limitations: Only PDF 9–10 reaccessed, not rest of paper. No equation implementation/automatic steady state/browser independence guarantee. Later Kalibera criticism retained.

exact_claim: S-0012: recorded execution/reanalysis differs from reexecuting archived resources
confidence_boundary: Higher narrow architecture distinction; not full capture/population validity
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Resource archives re-run a website from archived requests; WebREC directly records how browser behaved using modified Chromium/PageGraph. Reanalysis uses recorded runtime information without replaying responses.
limitations: Title page identifies arXiv 2501.15911v4, 4 Jun 2025. Architecture distinction only, not final-version substitution, full capture/population or timing-validation guarantee.

exact_claim: S-0012: version/pipeline-specific recording and outside-context/browser limits
anchor: arXiv v4 §4.2 p. 8; §4.4.2 p. 10; discussion p. 13
confidence_boundary: Limited browser-performance transfer; not unavoidable defects of all deployments
original_passage_snippet_or_faithful_sco: Pipeline: injected script tag leads quirks mode, srcdoc iframe hook gap, possible recording race. SVG-handler limitation addressed in newer version. Outside-page service workers/extensions and non-Chromium engines not catered for.
limitations: Version/pipeline-specific reported limits, not unavoidable defects of every deployment or browser-performance ground truth.
